records.readable_german: Akonach 18. Roehrensender an TAFUNK abgegangen. Hier 10 kW QOF-Sender Umformermotor fuer 220 Volt.
records.title: Transmitter dispatch and a 220-volt converter motor
records.meaning: A tube transmitter has been dispatched to TAFUNK. The remaining text lists a 10 kW QOF transmitter and a converter motor for 220 volts. AKONACH 18, QOF and TAFUNK retain their transmitted forms.
records.reading_note: The final group in the first ciphertext row is DGAGF. Its first glyph has a closed right-hand curve and no middle bar: D, not the E recorded in the earlier transcription. Source coordinate 35 therefore supplies plaintext separator X at position 9. All 166 source coordinates are readable, and the complete 83-position text re-encrypts exactly under the published Nov1–3 key. The 31 October heading and 2 November reception date are separate source dates.

transcription_review.classification: correction of our transcription; no source-coordinate substitution

records.readable_german: Dringendes Reklamationsgesuch Bruders Oberjaegers Steiling unterwegs. Erbitte drahtlich Nachurlaub bis Entscheidung. Hptm Steiling, Kriegsbekleidungsamt.
records.title: Steiling asks for additional leave pending a decision
records.meaning: An urgent application concerning the brother identified as Oberjaeger Steiling is on its way. Hptm Steiling of the military clothing office requests additional leave by telegram until a decision is made. This is a request, not evidence that leave was granted; no personal identity is assigned.

records.readable_german: 211?IVD marschiert bis 9 / 11 in Raum um TITELC. A. H. Q? 5 / 11 NAGQBECSEREK. Luftaufklaerung nichts Wesentliches.
records.title: March and aerial reconnaissance report
records.meaning: The report places the unresolved unit 211?IVD in the area of TITELC by 9 / 11. An A. H. Q? field gives 5 / 11 and the conditionally completed NAGQBECSEREK. The final clause reports no substantial aerial-reconnaissance findings.
records.reading_note: Two additional mask fills complete the place field as NAGQBECSEREK, supported by the native NAGQBE prefix and EREK ending in p120 C. Both sources name ZON as sender and give an origin day of 4. Their CS/SC difference and literal Q remain. The proposal has 98/100 fixed positions at two observed substitutions and eight mask fills; 211?IVD and Q? remain unresolved.

place_completion.interpretation: The place fields are treated as related spellings for this conditional proposal. Their shared prefix and ending support the missing A and E. The differing observed CS/SC sequence and Q remain as transmitted; no identical-message or historical spelling claim is made.

records.readable_german: Hier noch altes Personal. Wir senden wie verabredet. Wenn NICT mehr, dann ist OS? ausgeschieden.
records.title: Existing personnel and agreed radio transmissions
records.meaning: The sender says the previous personnel are still present and transmissions continue as agreed. The final sentence contains the literal defect NICT and an unresolved OS? label. If NICT is intended as NICHT, it conditionally links ceased transmissions with the departure of OS?; that missing H is not inserted into the cryptographic reading.
records.reading_note: The first source group is AXVFF; ALTES is already present in the complete raw reading. The later group VFFGF contains a clear F, not an out-of-alphabet T; neither visual correction is a historical ciphertext edit. The proposal changes one observed coordinate and fills three printed masks. The fourth mask leaves OS? unresolved. NICT is retained without adding H. Only the first of two announced parts is included.
